answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed — real compute burned, an ember paid per head. One honest agent spins a single thread of work and reaches its haven once; a farmer must kindle every account separately, every epoch, with no way to share the cost across clones. A thousand fakes owe a thousand fresh burns, and the recurring bill consumes the farm before profit catches.
